# Change summary

Describe the user-visible or internal change and why it is needed.

# Validation

List the canonical Make targets you ran, for example `make test` or `make qa`.

# Security / compatibility

Call out security-sensitive behavior, compatibility implications, migrations, or intentionally unchanged invariants.

# Checklist

- [ ] First-party package versions remain at the intended release version.
- [ ] New production behavior has regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when public behavior changed.
